newsitem.title: USA: Nextel, bondholders in preliminary deal.
newsitem.headline: Nextel, bondholders in preliminary deal.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc said on Saturday that it reached a preliminary understanding with a group of significant bondholders that would allow for the accelerated buildout of the Nextel National Network.
Included in the terms of the understanding would be the transfer of Nextel's 17 percent stake in Clearnet Communications Inc to McCaw International Ltd.
Nextel said in a news release that the agreement would bring it $257 million in new equity from the McCaw family, and greater flexibility in financing future growth.
Nextel hopes to extend its digital wireless network to cover 85 percent of America's population by the end of 1998.
Under the preliminary understanding, Nextel would pay consenting bondholders a cash fee equal to 2.5 percent of the principal amount due at maturity, a maximum aggregate amount of $67.5 million.
Bondholders would have the opportunity to buy Nextel stock in lieu of cash, the company said. The maximum total number of shares that would be issued is 5.5 million.
